## What you want to build
Only platform admins set up VPN servers. Each workspace then picks one of those VPN servers for its apps
to connect through.

## Inputs (what someone fills in when adding one)
- VPN server: name, address, port
- workspace VPN connection: which VPN server to use

## What should happen (after someone saves one)
Check the VPN server answers on its address and port.

## Result to show
- whether the server answered
- when it was last checked
